Subject: Discovery follow-up: Next demo & rotating time slots

Hi Liam—

Thanks again for the call today— really appreciated the time and the level of detail on Acme Health's latency and compliance needs. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Recap: You need predictable low-latency inference for synchronous clinical suggestions, strict audit logs for HIPAA, and predictable unit-costs across peak/weekend traffic.
- Next meeting: Technical deep-dive + demo with your SRE and security lead (30-45m). We can show a short live demo of a 2-step patient triage workflow and then walk through logs/retention/SLA controls.

To make scheduling easier across your US/EU/APAC teams, I prototyped a rotating weekly schedule so the meeting time cycles through US-friendly / EU-friendly / APAC-friendly windows. Rotating slots reduce the chance we always pick a time that excludes the same teammates. Suggested pattern (all times shown in their local zone):

Option A — rotating weekly (we rotate who gets the easy slot each week):
- Week 1 (US-friendly): Tue 09:00 PT / 12:00 ET / 17:00 BST
- Week 2 (EU-friendly): Tue 16:00 PT / 19:00 ET / 00:00 BST (+1)
- Week 3 (APAC-friendly): Tue 00:30 PT / 03:30 ET / 08:30 AEST

Option B — fixed compromise (if rotating is hard):
- Wed 15:00 BST / 10:00 ET / 07:00 PT — middle-ground that usually works for cross-regional teams.

Can you confirm which you prefer? If rotating, which timezone do you want to get the initial US-friendly slot for the first meeting? Also please confirm attendees: I expect Liam + Anika Mehta (SRE) + one security lead.

I've attached a short one-pager on our product (redwood-product-one-pager.pdf) and a tentative calendar link below. If you prefer, I can send a few one-click time proposals via Calendly.

Thanks — happy to adjust.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
